newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds aspire to 114-24, wary of PPI.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds aspire to 114-24, wary of PPI.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries appear constructive, technical analysts said on Friday, and will look to reach 114-24.
"The market has been building up for a week to get there, and looks pent up," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London.
He said 114-24 was a swing target of the correction from 112-24 on June 20 to 110-23 on June 30, projected from the 112-24 high.
September T-bonds were up 1/32 at 113-29 in automated trade by 1015 GMT.
David Wood, independent technical analyst near London, said in the short term T-bonds were positive while they held above 113-16 to 113-12.
He saw intermediate resistance targets at 114-09 and 114-12.
"Then there is a vacuum to 114-26 and the big high at 115-17," he said.
The September contract high was formed at 115-17 on December 3. There was also some psychological resistance at 115-00.
But the market may be wary of the U.S. producer price data due at 1230 GMT, Wood said. June producer prices are expected to be unchanged, compared with a 0.3 percent fall in May.
Wood said if the numbers were out of line, T-bonds could slip.
"We could be in for a sharp decline to 112-24 but it ought to bounce strongly from there," he said.
The European bank analyst said stops were likely to go off around 113-16, leaving support at 113-08. He said below there the market would be eyeing 112-18.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were up 0.005 at 94.075.
